title: Shas Spokesman Reacts
body: Shas spokesman Asher Medina calls a fatal ramming during a chareidi draft protest in Yerushalayim a "defining moment" in relations between the chareidi public and the state.

title: Yeshiva Bochur Released Early
body: Chevron Yeshiva bochur Yehuda ben Amram, held in a military prison, is set to be released Wednesday and return to the yeshiva. A festive reception is planned for his homecoming.

title: Yerushalayim Bus Tragedy Unfolds
body: Yosef Eisenthal, 14, was killed & 3 others injured in Yerushalayim when a bus struck them during an anti-draft protest on Shamgar. Initial police findings & eyewitness accounts detail the sequence of events.
